content.description: zkCodex is a wallet tracking and airdrop discovery platform designed for EVM-compatible networks and beyond. It supports 20+ blockchain networks and tracks 10+ airdrop opportunities, helping users monitor wallet activity, analyze asset performance, and uncover potential rewards from a single, unified interface. By bringing together on-chain activity and airdrop signals across multiple ecosystems, zkCodex provides a clear, comprehensive view of holdings and opportunities without switching between apps.
